full_prompt_en: A square sepia-black newspaper engraving depicts a satirical village street populated by dressed skeleton figures. A large skeleton in a wide-brimmed hat sits at center-left, its toothy skull turned in profile and a short stick or cigar held between its jaws. It wears a dark coat, patterned vest, neckcloth, and baggy trousers; one bony hand rests on a raised knee. Just to the right stands a smaller skeleton in a long ruffled dress and head covering, hands folded at the waist. Tiny background figures walk between simple pitched-roof houses and telegraph poles, giving the main pair a public, everyday setting. In the lower corners, a loose skull, small doglike skeleton, baskets, and scattered street objects crowd the cobbled ground. A rough stone wall frames the left edge, while an open sky with thin clouds and fine horizontal cuts sits behind the rooftops. The scene is densely narrated but arranged in clear tiers: large dark seated form in front, pale standing figure at its side, small houses and walkers behind. Every contour is built from thin, irregular printed strokes. Dense crosshatching makes the coat and wall nearly black; lighter parallel lines describe sky, cobbles, fabric folds, and bone surfaces. The image lies on yellowed, slightly stained paper with uneven borders, tiny registration blemishes, and faint marginal marks; any incidental small writing is not prominent. There is no vivid color or photographic lighting. Tonal separation and the preserved paper white imply a mild overhead day, with shadows supplied by engraving density. The result is playful and macabre, using popular-print roughness and sharp social caricature to make impossible figures feel like ordinary street residents.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形棕黑色旧报纸版画描绘挤满穿衣骷髅人物的讽刺村街。中央偏左，一具戴宽檐帽的大骷髅坐着，露齿头骨转为侧面，嘴间夹着一根短棍或雪茄。它穿深外套、花纹马甲、领巾和宽松裤子，一只骨手搭在抬起的膝上。它右侧站着一具较小骷髅，穿有褶边的长裙和头巾，双手交叠在腰间。微小背景人物走在简单尖屋顶房屋与电线杆之间，为前方两者提供公开的日常场所。下方角落里，散落头骨、小狗般的骷髅、篮子和街头杂物挤满鹅卵石地面。粗石墙框住左边，屋顶后是带薄云和细水平刻线的开放天空。场景叙述密集，但层级清楚：前方大型深暗坐姿形体、旁边浅色站姿形体，身后是小房屋和行人。每道轮廓由细而不规则的印刷笔痕建立。密集交叉排线使外套与墙壁几乎变黑；较浅平行线描述天空、石块、衣褶和骨面。图像印在泛黄、略有污渍的纸上，边框不匀，有细小套印瑕疵和淡边缘记号；零星小文字并不醒目。没有鲜艳色彩或摄影照明。明暗分隔与保留纸白暗示温和的白天顶光，阴影由刻线密度提供。结果滑稽而阴森，借民间印刷的粗糙感与尖锐社会漫画感，让不可能的人物像普通街坊一样存在。
style_prompt_en: An aged popular-print engraving uses black-brown ink on warm yellowed paper, with variable fine line width, dense crosshatching, stippled wear, and imperfect outer borders. Large dark shapes are built from closely packed directional cuts, while lighter areas preserve the paper and use sparse parallel strokes for texture. A prominent front mass is balanced by a narrower neighboring form, then many smaller narrative details recede into a shallow, busy backdrop. Architectural and organic contours are equally outlined, producing a lively, slightly coarse graphic unity. Sepia staining, uneven ink density, tiny margin blemishes, and hand-printed roughness remain visible. Lighting is represented through line density and paper-white highlights rather than smooth gradients or a physical lamp. The palette is intentionally narrow, so contrast, eccentric silhouette, and the rhythm of small marks carry the scene. The overall effect feels witty, dark, and historical, with theatrical figures presented in the ordinary visual language of an illustrated broadsheet.
style_prompt_zh: 旧式民间印刷刻画在泛黄暖纸上使用棕黑油墨，线宽细而有变化，交叉排线密集，磨损处带点状颗粒，外边框并不完美。大块深暗形状由紧密定向刻痕构成，较浅区域保留纸白，只用稀疏平行线添纹理。一块突出的前景体量由旁边更窄的形体平衡，许多更小叙事细节则退入浅而繁忙的后层。建筑式与有机轮廓同样被勾线，产生活跃、略粗的图形统一。棕褐污渍、不均匀墨量、微小边缘瑕疵和手印式粗糙感保持可见。照明由线密度和纸白高光表示，而非平滑渐变或实体灯光。配色刻意收窄，因此对比、奇特剪影和小笔痕节奏承担画面。整体诙谐、阴暗且有年代感，用插图小报的日常视觉语言呈现戏剧化形体。
theme_en: Satirical skeleton figures in a village street as an aged newspaper engraving
theme_zh: 旧报纸木刻中的村街讽刺骷髅人物
name: Jose Guadalupe Posada
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
